subject: VAT treatment & reverse-charge — invoice reissue and split collection plan
body_messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@zenwave.co.uk>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance AP <ap@zenwave.co.uk>
Date: 2027-05-04T09:12:00Z
Subject: VAT treatment for Redwood invoice 1234 - reverse charge?

Hi Vivek,

We received invoice #1234 dated 2027-04-30 and our AP team is asking whether ZenWave should self-account for VAT under the reverse-charge mechanism. Our procurement team is registered in the UK but the billing entity on the invoice is Redwood EU SL (Spain). Can you confirm: 1) whether Redwood considers this a B2B supply subject to reverse-charge, and 2) whether you can reissue a self-billing / reverse-charge invoice (or provide a note) so we can process payment?

If possible, please include a clear VAT ID for the billed entity and any split instructions if we need to allocate fees between ZenWave UK and ZenWave EU branches. AP is blocking payment (PO 9876) until we have this clarified.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement
ZenWave Ltd.

--
Elena Rossi
Elena.Rossi@zenwave.co.uk
Tel: +44 20 7946 0321
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@zenwave.co.uk>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T11:04:00Z
Subject: Re: VAT treatment for Redwood invoice 1234 - reverse charge?

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and sorry for the holdup. Short answer: this looks like a B2B digital services supply and reverse-charge is likely applicable, but we need to validate ZenWave's VAT ID and confirm the invoicing entity mapping on our side before we reissue.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Can you send a scanned VAT certificate or the VAT number you use on VAT returns? (we can accept a registration extract)
- We'll map which Redwood legal entity should bill (we currently show Redwood EU SL on the invoice). If ZenWave wants the charge allocated to the UK branch, we need a formal allocation instruction and may split the invoice accordingly.
- If reverse-charge applies, we will reissue invoice 1234 with a "reverse charge — customer to account for VAT" note and include both our Spanish VAT ID and your validated VAT ID.

Looping in Marissa (billing) and Ben (revenue ops) to coordinate the reissue and any split collection.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, EMEA
Redwood Inference
Phone: +44 77 5555 1212
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@zenwave.co.uk>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance AP <ap@zenwave.co.uk>
Date: 2027-05-04T12:28:00Z
Subject: Re: VAT treatment for Redwood invoice 1234 - reverse charge?

Hi Vivek — attaching our VAT registration extract and the internal allocation note.

Attachment: vat_certificate_zenwave.pdf (pdf, 320KB)

ZenWave would prefer the charge to remain on the UK P&L where possible; our tax team has confirmed reverse-charge will be applied on our side if the invoice shows Redwood EU as the supplier and includes our UK VAT number.

Let me know if you need a signed self-billing agreement or additional proof. Payment team would like an updated invoice within 48 hours if possible.

Thanks,
Elena
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-05T09:15:00Z
Subject: Internal: ZenWave — invoice reissue & split plan (draft)

Ben / Vivek — quick internal thread to confirm options. I reviewed the VAT extract and it looks valid (UK VRN). Proposed approach:

Option A (preferred for speed):
- Reissue invoice #1234 as Redwood EU SL (Spain), add explicit reverse-charge text: "VAT reverse charge — recipient to account for VAT under Article 194 of Council Directive 2006/112/EC".
- Include ZenWave UK VRN on the invoice. No monetary VAT line.
- Return reissued PDF to Elena for AP to pay.

Option B (if customer insists on UK billing):
- Create a split invoice: portion billed by Redwood UK Ltd (to be taxed under UK rules) and portion billed by Redwood EU SL. Requires internal ledger split and potentially delay for recognition & tax treatment.

Operational notes:
- We should not change the original invoice date for accounting; create a corrected/reissued invoice and reference original invoice.
- Attach a short self-billing confirmation if they provide a signed agreement (Elena indicated possible signed self-billing).

Ben — can you confirm any implications for revenue recognition and collection if we go with Option A vs B? Also, ensure our SAP/AR tags include ZenWave UK VRN to avoid future hold.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Billing Manager
Redwood Inference
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@zenwave.co.uk>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-06T15:37:00Z
Subject: Re: VAT treatment for Redwood invoice 1234 - reverse charge?

Hi Elena — thanks for the VAT extract and patience. We followed the billing playbook and prepared a reissued invoice PDF (attached) with the following:

- Supplier: Redwood EU SL (ES VAT: ESX12345678)
- Customer VAT: ZenWave Ltd. UK VRN: GB999888777
- Invoice note: "Reverse charge applies — customer to account for VAT. See Article 194/Directive 2006/112/EC."
- Original invoice referenced: "Correction of invoice 1234 dated 2027-04-30"


Attachment: redwood-invoice-1234-reissue.pdf (pdf, 42KB)

Please confirm receipt and whether AP is happy to proceed with payment against this reissued invoice. If ZenWave still requires the charge to be split onto UK entity, notify us and we will open a split-invoice request (this will require an internal accounting cutover and may delay payment by ~5 business days).

If you want a signed self-billing agreement on file, send it to billing@redwood.com and we'll attach it to the invoice metadata.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, EMEA
Redwood Inference
Phone: +44 77 5555 1212
